name: Roguelike
description: The run-based pack: a seeded run starts, procedural floors descend, the build is drafted mid-run, death is permanent, and the account advances anyway. It stands on the Dungeon Crawler kit — world.floor_descent owns the floor stack, inventory.affix_loot_generator owns the drops, progression.permadeath_flag owns the funeral — and adds the run-level contract those pieces assume but never declared: one seed to reproduce everything, a meta pool that outlives the run, drafts at level milestones, and an obituary that converts the loss into visible progress. The stance: a roguelike is not a dungeon crawler with death, it is a loop where death is the product, and every new component here exists to make the death reproducible, educational, and worth something.
loop: run starts → procedural floors → build draft → die → meta-progress

signatureCompound.name: One Run, Start to Funeral
signatureCompound.description: A complete run that proves the loop: run_seed_manager issues a reproducible seed, floor_descent derives floors from it and affix_loot_generator rolls drops from it, draft_on_level_up shapes the build at each level, permadeath_flag makes the final hit stick, run_meta_progression banks the credits, and death_summary shows the player exactly what the run was and what it bought.
